name: sift-movie-ratings-webextension

scripts.prebuild:dev: pnpm run clean && cp -r images dist
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run clean && cp -r images dist
scripts.publish:cws: pnpm run build && pnpm run zip:dist && node scripts/publishToCWS.js
scripts.publish:eas: pnpm run build --target=edge && pnpm run zip:dist && node scripts/publishToEAS.js
scripts.publish:mas: pnpm run build --target=firefox && pnpm run zip:dist && pnpm run zip:src && node scripts/publishToMAS.js
scripts.publish:all: pnpm run publish:cws && pnpm run publish:eas && pnpm run publish:mas

author: Anirudh Nimmagadda <anirudh.nimmagadda@gmail.com>
description: Sift adds IMDB ratings next to programs on various OTT platforms to help you choose what to watch faster.
